correctness.rationale: Fixed projective eigenplanes are y=±ix, and sextic homogeneity restricts the fourfold equation to 2f(x)=0, yielding precisely two disjoint genus-10 smooth curves. At each fixed point the involution acts +1 on the curve tangent and −1 on three normals; equivariant formal linearization gives A¹ times the 2-Veronese invariant cone, local multiplicity four and Reid–Tai age 3/2 (terminal, index2). Adjunction gives trivial source canonical; residue transformation has sign −1 and quotient is étale in codimension one, so the quotient reflexive canonical square is trivial but canonical itself is non-Cartier at singularities. Lefschetz gives Picard rank one. Source χ=2610, b4=2606; fixed curves χ=−36, trace_H4=−40 and invariant b4=1283, quotient Euler1287. Independent exact Chern/binomial and invariant trace arithmetic checks corroborated proof, not replacement for quotient theorems.
